ambiguities_or_notes: Грядущей ничтожности is kept close as ‘coming insignificance’ rather than strengthened into ‘worthlessness’ or generalized into fear of failure.
Горький залог is rendered literally as ‘bitter pledge’; the unusual abstraction is Tolstoy's and is not smoothed away.
Томящая грусть is rendered ‘tormenting sadness,’ preserving the repeated tormenting force of мучит / томящая.
